lines.text: The LORD will gather all the nations against Jerusalem, and then the LORD will go out to fight them.
The Mount of Olives will split in two, and the valley will reach to Beersheba.
Living water will flow out from Jerusalem, and the LORD will become King over all the earth.
The LORD will strike the peoples who warred against Jerusalem with a plague, and Judah will collect gold, silver, and apparel.
Survivors will go up yearly to celebrate the Feast of Weeks, and rain will not fall on Egypt if it stays away.
